settings.languageDesc: Choose the interface language. Takes effect immediately.
settings.themeDesc: Pick a theme, applied live. Each theme comes from a separate theme plugin.
settings.fontDesc: Fonts use the system stack, zero bundling. Theme / font size / font prefs persist across restarts.
settings.pluginOwnDesc: theme-manager's own prefs, stored at ~/.pi-desktop/config/plugins-data/theme-manager/config.json (separate from desktop prefs).
settings.modelsDesc: Manage pi's model providers and models (~/.pi/agent/models.json). Add/edit/remove providers and models; changes save via the top bar.
settings.otherFields: Other fields (parsed from the base .d.ts + actual settings.json, shown with no preset description)
settings.generalDesc: Desktop general config, consumed by internal modules
settings.defaultThinkingLevelDesc: Default thinking level for the chat page, used when user hasn't manually selected one
